notes: Encoded ONLY from Laars' own page. Page states Laars Heating Systems Co is a subsidiary of Bradford White Corp; the model lines listed on the page (Brute, Magnatherm, Mascot, Mighty Therm, Neotherm, Pennant, Rheos, Teledyne, etc.) are product lines, not sister brands sharing a serial system, so no sisters are claimed. Month is chart-only, so this style ships year-only per precedent.

styles.notes: Page positions 2nd-3rd numerical digits = year (1-based characters 2-3, converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]); the page example C00B01803 gives year digits '00', resolving to 2000 under the 1960 floor (1900 below floor, 2000 only candidate). Month = 1st letter digit per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping lives only in chart image Laars-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature1.png, so month is null and the style ships year-only pending the image pass.
